svg.text: Entrance & hallway · Option 01 · looking towards the front door
Bentwood hat-and-coat stand, dark walnut (replaces white pole)
Fortnum & Mason hamper moves under the console
Aged-brass lamp, pleated shade, warm bulb
Larger plain coir mat, full door width
Unchanged: walls and paint, console and mirror, tiles, panelling, stained glass, pendants. Illustrative, not to exact scale.
